newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK weather - cloudy and cool at first, fine later.
newsitem.headline: HK weather - cloudy and cool at first, fine later.

text.p: It will be cloudy and cool with some haze in the morning, fine and dry during the day, the Royal Observatory said on Thursday.
The maximum temperature will be about 20 C with moderate northeasterly winds, fresh offshore.
At 7 a.m. the temperature was 16 C and the relative humidity 69 percent.
Outlook for Friday: fine and dry. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
